buildVerified: next build + next start on localhost:3000; raw HTML fetched per user-agent

issues.evidence: Raw HTML of /privacy-policy/ renders 'Our privacy policy content is pending and will be published here.' The page is linked in the footer on every page (Footer.tsx ~line 308).
issues.why: A medical site collecting health data through the booking form ships an empty privacy policy — a direct YMYL trust failure and a legal exposure under Indian IT Rules.
issues.fix: Write the real privacy policy (what is collected via the booking form, Gmail delivery, no tracking, data retention, grievance contact) or temporarily remove the footer link. Needs client-approved wording.

issues.evidence: app/sitemap.ts sets lastModified: new Date() for every URL; sitemap.xml shows identical lastmod '2026-10-24T06:30:35.174Z' on all entries — i.e. build time, not content-modified time.
issues.why: Google treats uniformly fresh lastmod as untrustworthy and may ignore the field; also misleading for AI freshness signals.
issues.fix: Set lastModified from real data: post.date (or a new updatedAt field) for blog posts, a per-page constant for static/treatment pages.

affected: all /blog/* posts with faq blocks (30 of 37 posts)
issues.evidence: Page renders visible FAQ accordions for 30 posts (faq4-faq10 per post) but FAQPage JSON-LD is gated on post.role === 'support' (page.tsx ~line 263). Only /blog/when-cataract-needs-surgery-signs/ emits FAQPage.
issues.why: 30 pages have FAQ content in the DOM with no matching structured data — lost rich-result and AI-citation surface.
issues.fix: Emit faqJsonLd(faqItems) whenever faqItems.length > 0, regardless of role.

issues.evidence: procedureJsonLd() is only rendered in the fallback branch; all six treatment slugs have custom components, so no MedicalProcedure schema is emitted anywhere. Verified in raw HTML: only MedicalWebPage + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList + MedicalClinic.
issues.why: Treatment/service pages are the money pages; MedicalProcedure schema is the correct entity type and is currently absent.
issues.fix: Render procedureJsonLd(detail.slug) alongside medicalWebPageJsonLd in the custom-component branch.

affected: the 10 newest posts incl. all 4 pillars
issues.evidence: blog-links.ts has no entries for the 10 hospital-authored posts (lasik-*, diabetic-retinopathy-*, eye-checkup-*, pterygium-*, corneal-ulcer-keratitis-*, cataract-surgery-guide, corneal-transplant-surgery, dry-eye-*, glaucoma-symptoms-*, keratoconus-*). Their rendered bodies contain zero contextual <a> links.
issues.why: Pillars and flagship guides carry no in-copy links to treatments, doctors or siblings — breaks the required link pattern and wastes the strongest pages.
issues.fix: Add overlay link runs in blog-links.ts (or support-source links) for each of the 10 posts: link relevant condition/treatment/doctor/sibling targets.

issues.evidence: Pillars exist for cataract, glaucoma, keratoconus, corneal-transplant (role:'pillar'). Only ONE support article is registered (1-1 when-cataract-needs-surgery-signs). Glaucoma, keratoconus and corneal-transplant pillars have zero supports; cataract has 1 of 5. Legacy 26 posts belong to no cluster.
issues.why: The pillar-cluster model is designed but almost entirely unbuilt; pillars look isolated, supports unwritten.
issues.fix: Do NOT generate new medical articles automatically. List missing support topics per cluster (title, keyword, intent, outline) in the fix report as recommended next content; wire links as articles arrive.

issues.evidence: Homepage renders '40,000+ patients' and '15,000+ surgeries' chips (TrustPillars.tsx lines ~29-40) while site.ts marks both 'NOT VERIFIED — needs user confirmation'. Same figures on /about-us/ per its own comment.
issues.why: Unverified volume claims are live on a YMYL site — credibility and medical-advertising risk.
issues.fix: Either verify the numbers with the client (patient database/records) or remove/soften the chips until confirmed.

issues.evidence: No /terms, /medical-disclaimer, /editorial-policy or /medical-review-policy routes exist; none linked in footer. Only /privacy-policy/ (empty) exists.
issues.why: YMYL sites claiming 'all content medically reviewed' need a visible review-policy page; a disclaimer page is standard for health content.
issues.fix: Create Medical Disclaimer + Editorial/Medical Review Policy pages describing the real review process (byline date, both doctors); link in footer.

issues.evidence: Multiple URLs target identical primary intent (e.g. two corneal-ulcer posts, four eye-checkup posts, four local-intent 'eye hospital Vadodara' posts).
issues.why: Competing URLs split link equity and confuse ranking signals — classic cannibalization.
issues.fix: Per pair: merge weaker into stronger with 301 + consolidate links, or differentiate intent explicitly (one informational, one local/service).

issues.evidence: Computed <title> lengths (title + ' | Mungale Eye Hospital'): 30 posts exceed ~65 chars; worst: corneal-ulcer-treatment t147, lasik-* t120, thinking-of-lasik-surgery t120, ai-in-eye-care t115, glaucoma-awareness-month t114. Verbatim titles also carry defects: '7 Habit for New Year Eye Health Resolutions 2026' (typo), '7 Eye Care Helpful tips That You Need to Never Sacrifice On' (ungrammatical), 'Cataract Surgery Vadodara Gujarat:' (keyword stuffing).
issues.why: Over-length titles truncate in SERPs and dilute the primary keyword; typos damage YMYL trust.
issues.fix: Add seoTitle/metaDescription fields to legacy posts (field already exists on the meta type) with ≤60-char human titles.

issues.evidence: Byline shows only 'Medically reviewed by …'; no 'Written by'. BlogPosting schema sets author = the reviewing physician (or Organization), and dateModified is hardwired to datePublished (same value) — the 'Updated' UI path can never render.
issues.why: Author/reviewer conflation weakens E-E-A-T; a dateModified that always equals published is a dishonest freshness signal if content is ever edited.
issues.fix: Add a distinct author field (or 'Mungale Eye Hospital editorial team') and a real updatedAt per post; render 'Written by / Reviewed by / Updated' separately.

issues.evidence: curl -L: https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/contact-lenses/everyday-eye-care → 404 (on thinking-of-lasik-surgery). nei.nih.gov/index.php/... → 200 but legacy path (redirects). Practo doctor links → 403 to curl (likely bot-block — verify in browser).
issues.why: A 404 citation is a fabrication red flag for quality raters and AI engines.
issues.fix: Replace FDA link with a live FDA/AAO contact-lens page; update NEI URL to canonical path; verify Practo links in a browser.

issues.evidence: robots.txt names 'Claude-Web' (retired UA) and lacks explicit entries for Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, Perplexity-User, CCBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Applebot (plain). All bots still allowed via wildcard — verified 200 for all 11 test agents.
issues.why: Named-agent list should reflect current official UA names; a future blanket change could silently mis-scope.
issues.fix: Update the allow list to current UA names (keep wildcard allow).

issues.evidence: No X-Robots-Tag noindex for non-production environments; no VERCEL_ENV conditional headers. Production is indexable (good); preview protection unverified.
issues.why: Preview deployments of a YMYL site should be noindex.
issues.fix: Add headers() branch emitting X-Robots-Tag: noindex when VERCEL_ENV !== 'production' (or platform equivalent).

issues.evidence: Physician JSON-LD has no sameAs (Practo/Justdial profiles exist and are cited in post bodies); MedicalClinic sameAs lists only Facebook/Instagram/YouTube — no Google Business Profile, Practo or Justdial.
issues.why: sameAs is the primary entity-reconciliation signal for doctors/clinic in AI engines.
issues.fix: Add verified profile URLs to doctor data + clinic sameAs. Requires the real GBP/Practo URLs.

issues.evidence: Treatment OG images declared width 1600 height 2000 (portrait specialty photos).
issues.why: OG images should be 1200x630 landscape; portrait dims crop badly in shares and AI citations.
issues.fix: Generate proper 1200x630 OG crops per treatment or reuse og-default.jpg.

issues.evidence: No 'Sources' section on any article. External authoritative links exist inline for ~16 legacy posts; the 10 new posts and the support article have zero external citations.
issues.why: YMYL articles should list numbered sources; AI engines weight citable references.
issues.fix: Add a 'Sources' section rendering the post's external links; attach citation URLs to the new posts (NEI/AAO/peer-reviewed).

issues.evidence: Sitewide FAQ page has only 8 questions, 3 about eye donation; no treatment/cost/recovery coverage. FAQPage schema present and matches (good).
issues.why: Thin dedicated FAQ surface; misses high-intent questions (cost, insurance, recovery).
issues.fix: Expand with real patient questions per treatment; keep verbatim-only additions pending client answers.

issues.evidence: llms.txt is a hand-maintained static file listing only 1 of 37 patient guides; llms-full.txt is generated correctly from source. The static file will drift.
issues.why: Stale llms.txt under-represents the site to AI engines.
issues.fix: Generate llms.txt from the same content registry (route handler) or expand the guide list manually at each publish.

issues.evidence: Code TODOs flag two AI-generated covers: cataract guide cover shows before/after eye insets (can read as promised result), glaucoma cover shows a third-party brand logo on the tonometry device.
issues.why: AI-generated medical imagery with implied outcomes is a trust/compliance risk.
issues.fix: Swap for real clinic photography once client supplies/approves.

issues.evidence: 41 banned-phrase hits across legacy bodies ('crucial', 'vital', 'paramount', 'game-changer', 'cutting-edge', 'holistic', 'A Comprehensive Guide', 'The Bottom Line'). Literal 'Introduction' opens ahmed-glaucoma-valve-surgery; 'Eye Care in Vadodara, the centre of Gujarat, something is unfolding' (missing word) opens advanced-eye-care-in-vadodara; 'world-class care' claim; keyword-stuffed intros ('Cataract Surgery Vadodara Gujarat:').
issues.why: Legacy posts read as content-mill/AI copy — weak E-E-A-T on the site's biggest content block.
issues.fix: Rewrite the ~15 worst legacy posts to the human-voice style guide; queue all for doctor review.

issues.evidence: icon.png + apple-icon.png present via file conventions; no web manifest.
issues.why: Minor completeness item.
issues.fix: Add app/manifest.ts with name/icons/theme.

issues.evidence: Blog card covers render alt="" (38 empty alts on /blog/, 10 on home). Defensible as decorative (adjacent title link carries meaning) but the featured-story image is informative.
issues.why: Descriptive alts on editorial images aid image search and accessibility.
issues.fix: Give the featured cover a real alt; leave card thumbnails empty or use post title.

issues.evidence: /dev/palette exists in the build; robots meta noindex present; not in sitemap; no inbound links found.
issues.why: Harmless but shippable dev tooling.
issues.fix: Delete the route or add Disallow: /dev/ in robots for belt-and-braces.

issues.evidence: JSON-LD emitted as separate <script> blocks rather than one @graph; WebSite node only on home. Works, but the graph is not linked page-level (WebPage node absent on most templates).
issues.why: A unified @graph with per-page WebPage nodes is cleaner for entity resolution.
issues.fix: Optional: consolidate into a per-page @graph with stable @ids.
